findings.why_it_matters: A reader or tool walking the markdown heading tree cannot find the General Rules subsection of 2.3 (File Control Entry); its rules (1)-(8) appear to belong to the preceding subsection.
findings.detail: The section heading 2.3.4 General Rules is transcribed as a plain paragraph line, not a markdown heading, while every sibling subsection heading in this batch (e.g. '### 2.4.4 General Rules' on page 480, '### 2.5.4 General Rules' on page 481) is a ### heading. The heading is demoted to body text.
